He escaped, turned off phone, etc. This is likely "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (refusal to pay labor remuneration) under Article 277 of Criminal Law. Also possibly "逃税" no. The act of evading payment after order is "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". Also "非法占有" maybe "诈骗"? But not fraud, it's refusal to pay wages. The law: "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" punishes employers who, after being ordered by labor administrative department or people's court to pay wages, refuse to pay. So the crime is that. Also "逃避支付工资" could be "非法占有" but the main is "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". Also "逃匿" is not a separate crime unless there is "逃跑罪". But not. So answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬罪<eoa>.
